# Contacting Equinor

![](https://www.equinor.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.equinor.com%2Fimages%2Fh61q9gi9%2Fglobal%2F90e8c4ebb312ee5e851e6ed93798610d4a3d4feb-2770x1559.jpg%3Frect%3D346%2C0%2C2079%2C1559%26w%3D1100%26h%3D825%26fit%3Dcrop%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

## How to contact us

First things first. If your enquiry is urgent or related to a safety issue, please call us immediately at the number below.

### Headquarters: Equinor ASA

[**+47 51 99 00 00**](tel:+47 51 99 00 00)

Forusbeen 50,

4035 Stavanger,

Norway

**Secondly, to help us help you, please send your enquiry to the right team in Equinor.** You’ll find all our direct contacts below. We can only answer relevant enquiries, and _we don’t respond to questions about jobs or unsolicited sales offers._

![](https://www.equinor.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.equinor.com%2Fimages%2Fh61q9gi9%2Fglobal%2Fe79e0fa7328632b1a53cbadbff99d1455989ba3e-8688x5792.jpg%3Frect%3D483%2C0%2C7723%2C5792%26w%3D1100%26h%3D825%26fit%3Dcrop%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

## Ethics Helpline

If you wish to report a matter to our Ethics Helpline, please read more here:

[Ethics and compliance in Equinor](https://www.equinor.com/about-us/ethics-and-compliance)

![](https://www.equinor.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.equinor.com%2Fimages%2Fh61q9gi9%2Fglobal%2F8fceb4b5c783ccbe7c0648eeeb238b105be176d4-6720x4480.jpg%3Frect%3D374%2C0%2C5973%2C4480%26w%3D1100%26h%3D825%26fit%3Dcrop%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

## Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT)

If you believe an Equinor IT system or information resource is at risk, click here:

[CSIRT](https://www.equinor.com/about-us/csirt)

![](https://www.equinor.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.equinor.com%2Fimages%2Fh61q9gi9%2Fglobal%2Fbb66c1818d64670b391634c2d30ffff0b5d4905c-4288x2413.jpg%3Frect%3D51%2C0%2C3217%2C2413%26w%3D1100%26h%3D825%26fit%3Dcrop%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

## Equinor US Owner Relations

Information for landowners and interest owners in the USA, including royalties, payments, statements and contacts can be found via the link below.

[Equinor US Owner Relations homepage](https://www.equinor.com/where-we-are/us-owner-relations)

## Our media and investor contacts:

- [Investor relations contact persons](https://www.equinor.com/investors/contacts-investor-relations)
- [Debt and credit rating contact persons](https://www.equinor.com/investors/debt-and-credit)
- [Our registrar — DNB](https://www.equinor.com/investors/contacts-investor-relations#registrar)
- [Media contacts and press spokespersons](https://www.equinor.com/news-and-media/media-relations)
- [Commercial proposals (advertisements, paid-for editorial content, etc.)](https://www.equinor.com/news-and-media/media-relations#commercial-proposals)
- [Photo and video library for the press](https://www.equinor.com/news-and-media/photo-and-video)

## How to find us

- [Our main office locations in Norway](https://www.equinor.com/where-we-are/norway-how-to-find-us)
- [Local contact information for countries here](https://www.equinor.com/where-we-are)

## Careers

Jobs: If you wish to apply for a job, an apprenticeship or send us a CV, please go to our Careers page.

All our vacant positions are published there. We regret that we cannot help you with finding jobs. However, if you are having problems with an application, contact us using the Careers contact form linked to below.

- [Careers in Equinor — main page](https://www.equinor.com/careers)
- [Careers contact form](https://www.equinor.com/careers/contact#contact-form)
- [Invite us to your career fair – contact form](https://www.equinor.com/careers/contact#career-fairs)

## Contact form for general enquiries

For job enquiries or to order annual reports, or for reporting matters relating to ethics and Code of Conduct, please use the links above.

If none of the links are relevant and you wish to send us an e-mail, please use the form below. Please be as detailed as possible, stating all relevant information you already have, including any contacts, to help us understand your enquiry and help us find the right person to handle your request. Please do not include other personal data than name and contact details.

All fields with \* are mandatory.

Name\*

Email\*

Category

Please select an optionReport an error on our websiteContact a department or member of staffInvestor relationsLogin issuesOther

Submit form

## Other common contacts:

To share views about safety and environmental matters in our US offshore business, contact [SafetyandEnvironment@equinor.com.](mailto:MMPDPNpipelinecross@equinor.com?subject=Enquiry:%20Pipeline%20and%20cable%20crossing)

For enquiries concerning Methanol, please describe your requests in full and send them to [methanol@equinor.com.](mailto:methanol@equinor.com)

Authorities in Norway are asked to contact the company at [apost@equinor.com.](mailto:apost@equinor.com)

For enquiries relating to pipeline and cable crossings, and possible damages caused by proximity to these, please contact [MMPDPNpipelinecross@equinor.com.](mailto:MMPDPNpipelinecross@equinor.com?subject=Enquiry:Pipeline%20and%20cable%20crossing)

Our Data Protection Officer can be reached at [gm\_dataprotection@equinor.com.](mailto:gm_dataprotection@equinor.com)

- [Procosys support](https://procosys.equinor.com/)
- [Contact Equinor Pension](https://www.equinor.com/about-us/equinor-pension#contacts)
- [Download or order our latest annual report](https://www.equinor.com/investors/order-our-annual-report-on-print)

# Equinor in the US

Since 1987, Equinor has delivered safe and reliable energy to help power American society.

As a core country in Equinor’s international portfolio, the US presents a world-class opportunity set across oil & gas, renewable energy, and low-carbon value chains.

We’ve invested more here than in any other country outside of our Norwegian home base.

- [Where to find us in the US](https://www.equinor.com/where-we-are/united-states#offices)
- [US owner relations](https://www.equinor.com/where-we-are/us-owner-relations)
- [Careers in Equinor](https://www.equinor.com/careers)
- [Learn more about Equinor](https://www.equinor.com/)

![](https://www.equinor.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.equinor.com%2Fimages%2Fh61q9gi9%2Fglobal%2Fa19ff2fc11a316bec981980a4691b8945acc2bbd-3000x1688.jpg%3Fw%3D1100%26h%3D619%26fit%3Dcrop%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

## Oil and gas

We are one of the largest equity producers of oil and natural gas in the US with both onshore and offshore assets. Our portfolio produces with a fraction of the global industry average emissions.

[Read about our oil and gas activities](https://www.equinor.com/where-we-are/us-oil-and-gas)

![Wind turbines. Photo](https://www.equinor.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.equinor.com%2Fimages%2Fh61q9gi9%2Fglobal%2F29eab727813a4ff6aac6e3509110d9bf79acc602-4000x1714.jpg%3Frect%3D477%2C0%2C3046%2C1714%26w%3D1100%26h%3D619%26fit%3Dcrop%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

## Renewables and power

Equinor is a leader in America’s offshore wind industry, with Empire Wind set to become the first offshore energy development to provide power to New York City. Our portfolio has the potential to play a key role in meeting America’s growing energy demand.

[Read about our renewables and power activities](https://www.equinor.com/where-we-are/us-renewables)

![Sunset Ridge - battery storage. Photo](https://www.equinor.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.equinor.com%2Fimages%2Fh61q9gi9%2Fglobal%2F940c2a052474b6237087c80b16bcb276c319c93e-4000x2250.jpg%3Frect%3D403%2C0%2C3195%2C1798%26w%3D1100%26h%3D619%26fit%3Dcrop%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

## Battery Storage

Through East Point Energy, Equinor is delivering utility scale battery energy storage systems throughout the United States.

[Read more about our battery storage activities here](https://www.equinor.com/energy/onshore-renewables)

## Realizing our broad energy ambitions in the US

**The world needs more energy — but it must be affordable, reliable and accessible. How will we do it?**

By continuing to reduce emissions from oil and gas production, growing our portfolio in renewable energy and developing technology that fuels the future.

As demand for energy grows in the United States, our broad energy portfolio is ready to meet the increased demand with sustainable US-based power sources.

Our people are the most essential part of our company, and that’s why safety and security is our top priority. We focus on preventing all accidents related to people, assets and the environment by creating a strong culture of safety that is at the core of our procedures and operations in every facility.

**To share views about safety and environmental matters in our US offshore business, contact** [SafetyandEnvironment@equinor.com](mailto:SafetyandEnvironment@equinor.com)

- [Sustainability in Equinor](https://www.equinor.com/sustainability)
- [Our approach to sustainability](https://www.equinor.com/sustainability/our-approach)
- [Read more about health, safety and security in Equinor](https://www.equinor.com/sustainability/health-safety-and-security)

## Latest US news
